name: design
description: Skills for the design of a product's interface: review a screen or flow against usability heuristics, audit a page against WCAG 2.2 Level AA, set up design tokens, themes and component states, plan a small usability test with real people, write and review interface copy, structure a site's navigation and taxonomy, spec a design for build, and set the visual hierarchy, the responsive layout and the forms a screen is built from.
